destinations.name: Bridge
destinations.description: The captain's chair, conn and operations consoles, aft stations and the forward viewscreen.

destinations.name: Ten Forward
destinations.description: A panoramic lounge with a curved bar and seating overlooking the planet.

destinations.name: Engineering
destinations.description: The illuminated warp core, monitoring stations and a walkable ramp to the upper gallery.

destinations.name: Upper Engineering
destinations.description: Look down on the warp core, then follow the aft crosswalk and ramp to the lower deck.

destinations.name: Observation Deck
destinations.description: A small viewing platform overlooking the entire ship. Take flight for an exterior tour.

obstruction_aabbs.name: Warp core with illuminated containment rings

notes: All rooms have closed wall/ceiling solids and genuine open lift doorways.
Engineering upper level is reached by an 18.75% physical ramp.
No doors or seats require scripted state changes to permit circulation.

hull.name: Original Enterprise-D-inspired Galaxy silhouette

registry_panel.grid_note: 5 rows by 9 vertices, row zero at bow; each cell [j,i],[j,i+1],[j+1,i+1],[j+1,i] faces upward.

hull.collision: All hull placements create solid off; room floors own collision.
hull.source_geometry: Original parametric mesh construction; no third-party models.

notes: Original fan-world model and interiors. Ship guide uses native geometry; native client owns physics. First release: exterior, bridge, Ten Forward and engineering.
